People Ops: Heads up — rolling out a short privacy attestation window this week. Everyone with access to customer data or prod keys needs to confirm their attestation by Thursday 11:59pm PT. :clipboard:

People Ops: What to do: 1) Click the attestation link and sign (2 mins) 2) If you own a control, upload evidence or a one-line placeholder 3) Managers, verify your team's completions. Link: https://internal.redwood/attest-2026

Sam L. (Legal): Quick note: this attestation is part of our annual privacy/ICO readiness. Its required for anyone listed on the access roster. If you were offboarded in the last 60 days, please flag HR.

Jin P.: Do contractors need to sign? I have a short-term contractor on analytics who pulled telemetry last week.

People Ops: Yes — contractors with telemetry or customer data access must attest. If their contract prevents signatures, file an evidence placeholder and tag People Ops + Legal.

Marcus T.: Im missing a log export for CC-10. Can I upload a scheduled job screenshot as interim evidence?

People Ops: Thats fine — screenshot + the scheduled job ID + ticket link. Use subject prefix AT-CC10 in the upload form so reviewers can auto-link.

contractor-ella: Attested. Uploaded placeholder for audit log export, ticket #7892. Thanks for the quick office hours yesterday.

People Ops: Thanks! Office hours recap: Tue 9:30-11:00 PT was focused on naming conventions and the attestation form. Next drop-in: Wed 15:00-16:30 PT for evidence triage.

Sam L. (Legal): Heads-up for managers: look for two extra checks in the verification flow  data classification and third-party access. Please confirm both when you verify.

hr-bot: Automated reminder sent to 42 people in the attestation cohort. Follow-up scheduled in 48h.

compliance-bot: Trail created: attestation-1842150000. Reminder: incomplete items will show on the weekly risk digest.

Jin P.: Got it. Will push our outstanding items this afternoon and tag Marcus for review.

People Ops: Appreciated. If anything is blocked, add "BLOCKED" in the evidence notes and include the blocker owner + ETA. We'll escalate anything marked BLOCKED to the relevant director.

Marcus T.: Uploaded the screenshot + job ID. Marked placeholder as "in-progress" and added ticket link.

People Ops: Final note — managers, please complete verification by Friday EOD to give Legal time to reconcile before the monthly compliance report. We'll publish a short summary on #announcements when reconciliation completes. :sparkles:
